source_config.purpose: Independent development replication of the paper setup, seed43 on the user-provided H100; selected before either atom outcome was inspected
limitations_and_choices: The original rank-8 trained adapter and factors were not located in the public release; this retrains the setup, not the exact original checkpoint.
Paper rank-8 q/v settings override the released config's contradictory rank-32 seven-projection defaults.
Alpha64, dropout0.1, learning rate, epochs, length, warmup, packing and optimizer follow the remaining released training defaults; original rank-8 training metadata is unspecified.
One H100 uses 32 accumulation microbatches to preserve the released 8-GPU effective batch of 64; floating point reduction and batch ordering can differ.
Seed43 is also applied before adapter initialization for reproducibility; the release explicitly sets only the trainer and data seeds.
SFT uses the released packed full-text objective; extraction and factor fitting use summed completion-only cross entropy, as in the release.
The released projection uses products of Kronecker eigenvalues, not the corrected EKFAC lambda matrix, with epsilon1e-6.
Atom coherence and training reconstruction are descriptive development measurements, not held-out interpretation or batch magnitude forecasting results.

This is a separately frozen development replication on the same5000 documents, not a duplicate controller for seed42 or a test on untouched data. Seed43 changes document order, adapter initialization, stochastic training, curvature sampling and dictionary initialization together. Hardware differs from seed42.
source_config.comparison_scope: Reproducibility across training/data-order/factor-sampling/dictionary seed and GPU hardware jointly; not an isolated causal effect of seed or GPU and not confirmation

fitting_gradient_convention: Original per-document summed completion CE gradients.
batch_gradient_convention: Mean of eight per-document mean-token completion CE gradients.
probe_loss: Per-document mean-token completion CE with the original training EOS convention.
normalized_fit: Reuse the audited original 500-atom normalized fitting dictionary.
magnitude_fit: Fit the same 500-atom learner on projected fitting rows divided by one positive-row median norm, computed from fitting rows only. Relative row magnitudes remain. Alpha, seed and all other learning defaults are fixed.
encoding: Both arms encode unit projected batch directions with alpha .1 and restore each projected batch norm. This isolates dictionary learning geometry and does not confuse summed fitting CE with mean-token batch CE scale.
primary: Prospective per-batch/per-probe teacher-forced mean completion-CE change on 64 evaluation documents. Exact pre-update probe gradients contracted with each reconstructed batch gradient. No outcome regression or fitted scale.
calibration: Sixteen separate probe documents. Report predictions and actual changes descriptively, but never use them to select methods, rates or rescale predictions.
evaluation: All forecasts and original-adapter assertions locked before any of the 64 actual full-gradient SGD updates. The same actual update targets both dictionary arms. Restore all 136 LoRA tensors after every condition.

criteria.rule: Report both arms and both rates in both reused seeds. A strong phase-one loss-prediction result requires the meaningful-effect gate and both error thresholds in every seed/rate, using simultaneous intervals across two arms and two rates per seed. Weak effects are inconclusive. No winner promotion.

analysis: Wait for both runs. Audit full grids, source and output hashes, locks and restores. Report all per-probe/per-batch errors and tails. Independently bootstrap batches and probe source clusters, preserving pairing across arms and rates, 1000 replicates, seed 2026101409. Pointwise 95% intervals and Bonferroni simultaneous intervals across two arms and two rates per seed. No sampling-MC uncertainty for exact CE. Only development evidence on reused checkpoints. Do not infer interpretability from forecast accuracy or reinterpret CE prediction as generated behavior.
limits: This focused phase makes no unrestricted sampled-behavior prediction claim. It does not repeat failed proposal reweighting or expand proposal banks. A separate frozen study is required before any generation-behavior claim.
